title: FFmpeg 9.0
summary: FFmpeg 9.0 is a major release of the industry-standard open-source multimedia framework for video and audio encoding, decoding, transcoding, streaming, and filtering. This version continues FFmpeg's evolution as the most comprehensive command-line multimedia toolkit available, supporting virtually all audio/video codecs and formats.
problem_solved: Provides cross-platform command-line tools for processing, converting, and streaming audio/video content in virtually any format
why_valuable: As the de facto standard for multimedia processing, FFmpeg enables developers and content creators to handle any video/audio task without proprietary software dependencies
